content.text:
Nvidia, Meta, Intuit, Salesforce, Zoom, Kohl’s, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Stock futures traded mostly lower Wednesday as the personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, for July revealed inflation was a bit stronger than expected.
